mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS assetId, a.entry_id AS entryId, -- 条目名称 / 编号：工作台底部状态栏要展示「属于哪条数据集合包」，缺失时回落到文件名 COALESCE(e.entry_name, a.file_name) AS entryName, e.entry_no AS entryNo, a.file_name AS fileName, a.file_url AS fileUrl, a.thumbnail_url AS thumbnailUrl, a.media_type AS mediaType, ja.sort_order AS sortOrder, -- 逐帧插值需要按各帧自身分辨率归一化：同一条目内帧分辨率可能不同（如 1920x1080 混 960x544） a.width AS width, a.height AS height, a.frame_flag AS frameFlag, a.invalid_reason AS invalidReason, -- 「数据明细」面板：条目所属批次与流转状态、标注员/审核员 COALESCE(b.batch_name, b.batch_no) AS batchName, e.label_status AS entryLabelStatus, e.review_status AS entryReviewStatus, COALESCE(su.nick_name, su.user_name) AS assigneeName, COALESCE(ru.nick_name, ru.user_name) AS reviewerName FROM label_job_asset ja JOIN label_asset a ON a.id = ja.asset_id LEFT JOIN label_data_entry e ON e.id = a.entry_id LEFT JOIN label_asset_batch b ON b.id = e.batch_id LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.user_id = e.assignee_id LEFT JOIN sys_user ru ON ru.user_id = e.reviewer_id WHERE ja.job_id = #{jobId} AND a.deleted = 0 ORDER BY ja.sort_order, ja.id

SELECT t.task_no AS taskNo, t.task_name AS taskName, t.data_type AS dataType, COALESCE(b.batch_name, b.batch_no) AS batchName, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM label_data_entry e2 WHERE e2.deleted = 0 AND e2.task_id = j.task_id AND (j.batch_id IS NULL OR e2.batch_id = j.batch_id)) AS batchEntryCount, j.data_type AS mediaType FROM label_job j JOIN label_task t ON t.id = j.task_id AND t.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN label_asset_batch b ON b.id = j.batch_id WHERE j.id = #{jobId}

SELECT a.id AS assetId, a.entry_id AS entryId, COALESCE(e.entry_name, a.file_name) AS entryName, e.entry_no AS entryNo, a.file_name AS fileName, a.file_url AS fileUrl, a.thumbnail_url AS thumbnailUrl, a.media_type AS mediaType, a.id AS sortOrder, a.width AS width, a.height AS height, a.frame_flag AS frameFlag, a.invalid_reason AS invalidReason FROM label_asset a JOIN label_job j ON j.project_id = a.project_id AND j.data_type = a.media_type LEFT JOIN label_data_entry e ON e.id = a.entry_id WHERE j.id = #{jobId} AND a.deleted = 0 ORDER BY a.id

SELECT a.id AS assetId, a.file_name AS fileName, a.file_url AS fileUrl, a.thumbnail_url AS thumbnailUrl, a.media_type AS mediaType FROM label_asset a JOIN label_job j ON j.project_id = a.project_id WHERE j.id = #{jobId} AND a.media_type = 'image' AND a.deleted = 0 AND (j.batch_id IS NULL OR j.batch_id = 0 OR a.batch_id = j.batch_id) ORDER BY a.file_name, a.id

SELECT pao.object_key AS objectKey, pao.object_type AS type, pao.class_id AS classId, COALESCE(c.label_name, pao.class_name) AS className, c.color, pao.asset_id AS assetId, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(pao.geometry_json, '$')) AS geometryJson, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(pao.attr_json, '$')) AS attrJson, 0 AS pointCount FROM label_pre_annotation_object pao JOIN label_pre_annotation pa ON pa.id = pao.pre_annotation_id AND pa.deleted = 0 JOIN label_job_asset ja ON ja.asset_id = pao.asset_id AND ja.job_id = #{jobId} LEFT JOIN label_class c ON c.id = pao.class_id WHERE pao.deleted = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM label_annotation a WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.job_id = #{jobId} AND a.asset_id = pao.asset_id ) ORDER BY pao.asset_id, pao.id

SELECT ao.object_key AS objectKey, ao.object_type AS type, ao.class_id AS classId, c.label_name AS className, c.color, ao.group_key AS groupKey, ao.track_token AS trackToken, a.asset_id AS assetId, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(ao.geometry_json, '$')) AS geometryJson, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(ao.attr_json, '$')) AS attrJson,
COALESCE( CASE WHEN JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(ao.geometry_json, '$.pointIndices')) = 'ARRAY' THEN JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(ao.geometry_json, '$.pointIndices')) ELSE JSON_EXTRACT(ao.geometry_json, '$.pointIndices.n') END, 0) AS pointCount FROM label_annotation a JOIN ( -- 每个 (job, asset) 只取最新一条 header：历史 bug 曾对同一帧重复插入多条 -- header，对象行散挂在各条上 —— 不收敛的话，保存删的是最新 header 的行， -- 加载却把老 header 上的活跃行全部带回来（「删除保存成功、刷新又回来」） SELECT job_id, asset_id, MAX(id) AS id FROM label_annotation WHERE deleted = 0 AND job_id = #{jobId} GROUP BY job_id, asset_id ) cur ON cur.id = a.id JOIN label_annotation_object ao ON ao.annotation_id = a.id AND ao.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN label_class c ON c.id = ao.class_id WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.job_id = #{jobId} ORDER BY ao.id

SELECT c.id AS classId, c.label_name AS className, c.color, cs.id AS classSetId, cs.name AS classSetName, c.tool_type AS toolType, c.default_size_l AS defaultSizeL, c.default_size_w AS defaultSizeW, c.default_size_h AS defaultSizeH, c.is_rigid AS isRigid, c.min_inside_points AS minInsidePoints, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(c.keypoint_template_json, '$')) AS keypointTemplate FROM label_job j JOIN label_class_set cs ON cs.project_id = j.project_id AND cs.deleted = 0 JOIN label_class c ON c.class_set_id = cs.id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE j.id = #{jobId} ORDER BY c.sort_order, c.id
SELECT id FROM label_annotation WHERE job_id = #{jobId} AND asset_id = #{assetId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT a.job_id AS jobId FROM label_annotation a WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.asset_id = #{assetId} ORDER BY a.update_time DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE label_annotation SET status = #{annotationStatus}, annotation_json = #{annotationJson}, updated_by = #{userId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{annotationId}

UPDATE label_annotation_object ao JOIN label_annotation a ON a.id = ao.annotation_id AND a.deleted = 0 AND a.job_id = #{jobId} SET ao.deleted = 1, ao.updated_by = #{userId}, ao.update_time = NOW() WHERE ao.deleted = 0
AND a.asset_id NOT IN
#{assetId}
AND 1 = 1

INSERT INTO label_annotation_object ( annotation_id, object_key, object_type, class_id, group_key, geometry_json, attr_json, track_token, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES
(#{p.annotationId}, #{p.objectKey}, #{p.objectType}, #{p.classId}, #{p.groupKey}, #{p.geometryJson}, #{p.attrJson}, #{p.trackToken}, #{p.userId}, #{p.userId})
mapper.select: SELECT a.asset_id AS assetId, a.id AS annotationId FROM label_annotation a JOIN ( -- 与加载口径一致：每个 asset 只认最新 header（历史重复行见加载 SQL 注释） SELECT asset_id, MAX(id) AS id FROM label_annotation WHERE deleted = 0 AND job_id = #{jobId} GROUP BY asset_id ) cur ON cur.id = a.id WHERE a.job_id = #{jobId} AND a.deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE label_annotation_object SET deleted = 1, updated_by = #{userId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE deleted = 0 AND annotation_id IN #{aid}
mapper.select: SELECT track_token AS trackToken, entry_id AS entryId, class_id AS classId, first_asset_id AS firstAssetId, last_asset_id AS lastAssetId, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(holes_json, '$')) AS holesJson, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(gaps_json, '$')) AS gapsJson, interpolation FROM label_object_track WHERE deleted = 0 AND job_id = #{jobId} ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE label_object_track SET class_id = #{classId}, first_asset_id = #{firstAssetId}, last_asset_id = #{lastAssetId}, holes_json = #{holesJson}, gaps_json = #{gapsJson}, interpolation = #{interpolation}, updated_by = #{userId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE deleted = 0 AND track_token = #{trackToken}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO label_object_track ( project_id, job_id, entry_id, track_token, class_id, first_asset_id, last_asset_id, holes_json, gaps_json, interpolation, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( -- project_id 由 job 反查回填：JobVO 不携带项目维度，避免为此再查一次表 (SELECT project_id FROM label_job WHERE id = #{jobId}), #{jobId}, #{entryId}, #{trackToken}, #{classId}, #{firstAssetId}, #{lastAssetId}, #{holesJson}, #{gapsJson}, #{interpolation}, #{userId}, #{userId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE label_asset SET label_status = CASE WHEN label_status = 'revising' AND #{labelStatus} = 'labeling' THEN 'revising' ELSE #{labelStatus} END, updated_by = #{userId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{assetId} AND deleted = 0

UPDATE label_asset SET label_status = CASE WHEN label_status IN ('unrevised', 'revising', 'revised') THEN 'revised' ELSE 'labeled' END, review_status = 'none', updated_by = #{userId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{assetId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT entry_id FROM label_asset WHERE id = #{assetId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT label_status FROM label_data_entry WHERE id = #{entryId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE label_asset SET label_status = #{labelStatus}, review_status = 'none', updated_by = #{userId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE deleted = 0 AND entry_id = #{entryId} AND label_status <> 'abandoned'
UPDATE label_data_entry SET label_status = #{labelStatus}, review_status = 'none', updated_by = #{userId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE deleted = 0 AND id = #{entryId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.entry_id) AS total, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN IFNULL(e.label_status, a.label_status) IN ('labeled', 'revised', 'skipped', 'abandoned') THEN a.entry_id END) AS done FROM label_job_asset ja JOIN label_asset a ON a.id = ja.asset_id AND a.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN label_data_entry e ON e.id = a.entry_id AND e.deleted = 0 WHERE ja.deleted = 0 AND ja.job_id = #{jobId}

SELECT c.id FROM label_job j JOIN label_class_set cs ON cs.project_id = j.project_id AND cs.deleted = 0 JOIN label_class c ON c.class_set_id = cs.id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE j.id = #{jobId} AND c.label_name = #{className} LIMIT 1

SELECT c.id FROM label_job j JOIN label_class_set cs ON cs.project_id = j.project_id AND cs.deleted = 0 JOIN label_class c ON c.class_set_id = cs.id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE j.id = #{jobId} ORDER BY c.sort_order, c.id LIMIT 1

UPDATE label_object_comment SET deleted = 1, updated_by = #{userId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{commentId} AND deleted = 0
AND created_by = #{userId}
UPDATE label_object_comment SET status = #{status}, updated_by = #{userId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{commentId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.annotation_json, '$.comment')) FROM label_annotation a WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.job_id = #{jobId} AND a.asset_id = #{assetId} ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.annotation_json, '$.globalAttrs')) FROM label_annotation a WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.job_id = #{jobId} AND a.asset_id = #{assetId} ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT a.asset_id AS assetId, a.job_id AS jobId, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.annotation_json, '$.globalAttrs')) AS globalAttrs, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.annotation_json, '$.comment')) AS comment FROM label_annotation a WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.asset_id IN #{aid} ORDER BY a.asset_id, a.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE label_asset SET frame_flag = #{frameFlag}, invalid_reason = #{invalidReason}, invalid_by = #{userId}, invalid_time = NOW(), updated_by = #{userId}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{assetId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT frame_flag FROM label_asset WHERE id = #{assetId} AND deleted = 0
